facts.material: not stated; assumed working ends of steel (with or without wooden/plastic handles)
facts.function: hand tools to cut, trim, shape and model clay
facts.form: hand-operated tools, possibly put up as a set

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8205 covers handtools not elsewhere specified or included; clay cutters, loop and ribbon tools are not named in a more specific chapter 82 heading
GRI 3(b) (if put up as a set): the steel edged cutting tools give the essential character
GRI 6: 8205.59 other handtools > 8205.59.55 other, of iron or steel > edged handtools > 8205.59.55.10 other

rejected_alternatives.reason: the clay cutting tools have cutting edges, so the edged handtools line applies
would apply only to tools with working parts of wood
would apply only to tools wholly of plastic; chapter 82 needs a base metal working part

missing_facts: What is the working part of the tools made of (steel, other base metal, wood or plastic)?
classification.rationale: Clay cutting and modeling tools are handtools not elsewhere specified in heading 8205. Assuming steel working edges, they fall in 8205.59.55 as other handtools of iron or steel and, being edged, in statistical line .10. In-force ruling M83095 classified a comparable pottery tool set (wire clay cutter, loop and ribbon tools, modeling tools) in 8205.59.5510.
